Fendt develops and produces intelligent, reliable and resource-efficient products. Fendt offers concrete solutions for climate-friendly and resource-conserving agriculture.
OutRun™ Tillage streamlines operations during both fall and spring tillage, enabling teams to concentrate their efforts on the two most vital phases of the crop cycle: harvest and planting.
In the fall, having the flexibility of autonomy means tillage can be performed right after the combine pass, maximizing the period for nutrients to return to the soil before spring planting.

In the spring, autonomy allows for maximizing the ideal window for fertilizer application and spring tillage, minimizing nutrient loss, and giving the team added capacity to keep the planter running at all times.

Farmers have a limited window to complete harvest. An extended harvest outside this ideal window leads to a significant reduction in yields. AGCO is a major worldwide manufacturer and distributor of agricultural equipment. AGCO offers a full product line including tractors, combines, hay tools, sprayers, forage equipment and implements through more than 3,000 independent dealers and distributors in over 140 countries.
Reinvented itself: The Fendt factory network

In Asbach-Bäumenheim, production begins with the delivery of raw material to the factory in the form of tubes, profiles and sheets of metal. Within the single piece production system, state-of-the-art technology and high-tech systems, such as flatbed or 5-axis lasers, form the basis for exceptional quality and unique design.

The Breganze factory is AGCO Harvesting’s center of excellence: a site where over six decades of experience in building self-propelled combine harvesters meets modernization. The result is combines manufactured by a dedicated team in line with the latest production standards which meet the highest demands for quality.

Thanks to continuous investments in production machinery and work conditions, the plant aims to achieve sustainable growth and enhance its productivity, while maintaining its high-quality production process. The new logistics center and the recent introduction of a new assembly line, based on a mixed-model production concept, are just a couple of examples of this constant progress.

The high-power combine, the Fendt IDEAL, and the 5- and 6-straw walker models are produced at our site in Italy. The conventional models are distributed throughout Europe, while the IDEAL units are shipped around the world. This ultra-modern plant occupies around 25 hectares and has a headcount of more than 900 workers.

Designed by a global engineering team, the Fendt Momentum planters are built in Beloit, Kansas, for North American producers. The Momentum planter is easily customized with popular and industry-leading technologies from Precision Planting®, making it sophisticated yet simple to operate.
